name: Chime
summary: Chime told staff on 31 July 2026 that it was cutting about 10% of the company, roughly 150 people, in a memo from CEO Chris Britt.

facts.label: People affected
facts.figure: about 150 people, 10% of a company of about 1,500
facts.detail: Announced in an internal memo from CEO Chris Britt.

facts.label: California WARN filing
facts.figure: 135 people at the San Francisco site, notice dated 31 July 2026
facts.detail: WARN is the public notice an employer files with the state ahead of a large layoff. It counts one site, so it is smaller than the company-wide figure.
facts.source_name: California WARN filings via WARN Firehose
